name: NBA pre-game heavy favourite
description: Taker buy of the NBA game-winner side whose ask is 90-96c, 12-30 h before the expected end of the game (trigger: a taker buy print), one entry per game, held to settlement.
hypothesis: Heavy NBA favourites are underpriced pre-game (favourite-longshot bias): +4-5c after fee in trade-print screen (t=11.7, both halves), +2..+6c on recorded asks. Counterparty: retail backing underdogs/parlays. Wrong if walk-forward CI <= 0. Known limit: ~10 games/month so the CI will be wide; window read off the screen.
